page.title: Per-campus visit registration
page.subtitle: Each campus is an independent section: its own schedule, guest list, working contact and requirements.

sections.contactDesc: The contact person manages the request and signs in with Google using this email. If it is someone else, they will receive a confirmation email.
sections.campusesDesc: Add one card per campus. You can copy content between campuses — after copying, every campus is still edited independently.
sections.contactInternalNotAllowed: The contact person must represent the visiting delegation, not the internal staff member creating the request on their behalf.

registrant.matchesAccount: This email matches your signed-in account — no OTP verification needed.
registrant.requiresOtp: The registrant email differs from your signed-in account. An OTP will be sent to that email to verify it before the request is created.
registrant.autofillFailed: Could not load your profile. Please try again or fill the fields in manually.

card.applyToAll: Apply this content to the remaining campuses…
card.operationalContactHint: Coordination only at this campus — never a login account
card.quickFillIndependent: These details are now edited independently — later changes to the source do not flow back here.
card.quickFillReplaceTitle: The current on-site contact details will be replaced.

excel.parseFailed: Could not read the Excel file.
excel.importedSupport: Imported {{count}} support members for this campus.
excel.replaceAll: Replace the whole list with this file
excel.replaceConfirmBody: All {{current}} people currently listed will be removed and replaced by {{count}} from {{fileName}}. Anything typed by hand will be lost.

report.failedTitle: The file could not be imported
report.overLimitHint: This campus has only {{remaining}} place(s) left (maximum {{max}}). Nothing was imported — shorten the list and try again.
report.formUnchanged: The form is unchanged. Fix the file and upload it again.
report.title: Excel check report

applyAll.title: Apply to the remaining campuses?
applyAll.overwrites: The content already entered for these campuses will be OVERWRITTEN: {{campuses}}.
applyAll.noOverwrites: The remaining campuses are empty — they will receive a copy of this campus.
applyAll.independentAfter: After applying, each campus is still edited independently (no automatic syncing).

remove.title: Remove a campus with content?
remove.body: "{{campus}}" already has data. Removing this card will discard everything entered for that campus.

draft.migrated: Your previous draft (shared form) was converted to the per-campus layout — review each campus card before submitting.
draft.foundAt: A draft saved at {{time}} was found. Restore it?
draft.savedForLater: Your request has been saved. You can finish verifying the email later.
draft.pendingOtpTitle: This request is waiting for email verification
draft.pendingOtpBody: A verification code was sent to {{email}}. You can enter it without filling the form in again.
draft.resumeOtpUnavailable: That verification code can no longer be used. Submit again for a new one — your answers are kept.

modal.title: Campus visit registration
modal.discardBody: You have entered data in this form. Closing now will dismiss this window.

success.title: Visit request submitted
success.idempotentReplay: This request was already recorded (resubmitting did not create a duplicate).
success.claimPending: The contact person differs from the registrant: a confirmation email has been sent (valid 72 hours). Campus approvals do not wait for this confirmation.
success.keepCode: Please keep the request code and check your email for the next steps.
success.codeCopyFailed: The browser blocked automatic copying. Your request code: {{code}}

summary.heading: Submitted request summary
summary.partnerNew: New organization (not linked to a partner)

amend.title: Propose a change — {{campus}}
amend.activeStaysNote: The active content stays unchanged until a Staff Leader approves the proposal.
amend.errAlreadyPending: This campus already has a pending proposal. Please wait for it or withdraw the current one.
amend.errWindowExpired: The visit starts within 24 hours, so self-service changes are closed. Please contact FPTU.
amend.errNotEditable: This campus cannot accept a change proposal right now.
amend.errConflict: The data changed since you opened this. Please reload and try again.
amend.errGeneric: Could not submit the proposal. Please try again.

members.needOne: At least one guest is required.
members.noChange: No member changes vs. the active content yet.

safeEdit.title: Quick edit (applies immediately)
safeEdit.applyNowNote: Administrative / privacy corrections apply immediately, no approval needed.
safeEdit.emailImmutable: The account email cannot be changed here.
safeEdit.conflict: The data changed since you opened this. Please reload and try again.
safeEdit.errGeneric: Could not save the changes. Please try again.
safeEdit.noChanges: You have not changed anything yet.
safeEdit.lockedCampuses: Quick edit is unavailable for: {{campuses}}. These campuses are under way, finished, not yet approved, or past the change deadline.

hostTransfer.title: Transfer the host
hostTransfer.keepsApproval: Transferring the host does not affect the approval, the schedule or the programme. The request is not re-approved.
hostTransfer.loadFailed: Could not load the host list. Please try again.
hostTransfer.noCandidates: This campus has nobody eligible to take over as host.
hostTransfer.reasonPlaceholder: For example: the current host's travel schedule changed.
hostTransfer.conflictWarning: Overlaps {{count}} other activity in this time window.
hostTransfer.conflictAck: {{name}} has an overlapping commitment in this window. You may still choose them — this is only a warning.
hostTransfer.conflict: This campus was just changed by another action. Please reload and try again.
hostTransfer.errGeneric: Could not transfer the host. Please try again.

mutationCutoff.rule: This action is only possible at least {{hours}} hours before the visit starts.

detail.notfound: Request not found or the per-campus feature is not enabled.
detail.forbidden: You are not allowed to view this request.
detail.generic: Could not load the request detail. Please retry.
detail.noCampusInScope: No campus in your viewing scope.

edit.subtitle: Edit each campus independently. The registrant and contact emails cannot be changed here.
edit.contactImmutable: The contact email is bound to the login account — not editable while editing the request.
edit.resubmitCampusFixed: On resubmit the campus set stays fixed; only the content is edited.
edit.forbidden: You are not allowed to edit this request.
edit.notEditable: This request is no longer editable. Please go back.
edit.notResubmittable: This request cannot be resubmitted. Please go back.
edit.conflict: This request was updated elsewhere. Reload the latest data and try again — your changes were not saved.
edit.submitFailed: Could not save. Please try again.

history.loadFailed: The change history could not be loaded.
history.empty: No changes have been recorded yet.

events.REQUEST_SAFE_EDIT_APPLIED: {{actor}} made a quick update to the request's information.
events.REQUEST_RESUBMITTED: {{actor}} resubmitted the request after it was rejected.
events.INSTANCE_SAFE_EDIT_APPLIED: {{actor}} made a quick update to the content for {{campus}} — version {{formRevision}}.
events.INSTANCE_AMENDMENT_APPLIED: An approved change was applied to the content for {{campus}} — version {{formRevision}}.

contact.pendingNotice: {{email}} has not accepted the invitation yet (valid for 72 hours). Campus approvals do not wait for this confirmation.
contact.activeNotice: The current contact has confirmed and is managing this request. Need somebody else? Send a transfer invitation.
contact.transferPending: Waiting for {{email}} to take over the contact role (valid until {{expiresAt}}). The current contact keeps every right until then.
contact.transferKeepsRights: The current contact keeps every right until the new person signs in with the matching Google account and accepts (valid for 24 hours). The previous contact's account is not deleted or locked.
contact.transferEmailUnchanged: That address already holds the contact role. Enter the email of the person taking it over.
contact.transferLoadFailed: Could not check the transfer status. Whether an invitation is pending is currently unknown.
contact.actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

outcome.title: Current status
outcome.allRejected: This request was rejected at every campus.
outcome.seePerCampus: See each campus below for the detailed decision.
outcome.noCampus: No campus in your viewing scope.

schedule.endAfterStart: The end time must be after the start time.
schedule.minDuration: A visit must last at least {{minutes}} minutes.
schedule.minAdvance: The start must be at least {{hours}} hours from now.
schedule.invalidDateTime: That date and time is not valid.
schedule.noEndSlots: No slots left on this day — switch on "Ends on another day".
schedule.rulesHint: Book at least {{hours}} hours ahead; each visit lasts at least {{minutes}} minutes.

otpFlow.codeSent: A verification code was sent to {{email}}.
otpFlow.codeResent: A new verification code was sent.
otpFlow.verifyingAndCreating: Verifying the code and creating the request...
otpFlow.reviewBannerTitle: A verification code was sent to {{email}}.
otpFlow.reviewBannerBody: Check the request and then carry on entering the code — the code you already have is still valid.

uncertain.title: The result could not be confirmed
uncertain.body: The connection dropped after the verification code was sent, so it is not yet known whether the request was created.
uncertain.doNotResend: Do not submit a new request yet — this one may already exist.
uncertain.checkFailed: The status could not be checked. Please try again in a moment.
uncertain.statePending: No request was created — the verification session is still open. Go back to the form and enter the code to finish.
uncertain.stateFailed: This submission ended without creating a request. Go back to the form and submit again.
uncertain.stateNotFound: No trace of this submission was found. Nothing was created — go back to the form and submit again.
